intro.text: A brightlord with a wizened face who attends King Elhokar's feasts on the Shattered Plains.
An elderly Alethi brightlord on the Shattered Plains, associated with Highprince Vamah.

items.text: At one of Elhokar's feasts, Wit mocked Cadilar by comparing his wizened face to that of his horse.
The keeper of a waystop on Cadilar's lands let Kaladin and the parshmen he was travelling with shelter there from a highstorm.
